name: Agent Threads
author: Adam Ritter
description: A Herdr replacement using native windows, so I don't have to learn its window-management key bindings. It's a keyboard-controlled sidebar for local or remote Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode threads. I use Super+S to toggle it and Super+A to focus it and switch threads. It shows busy threads and supports projects, remotes, pinning, renaming, vi-like navigation, and global/per-workspace visibility. State persists across restarts, and the selected thread follows you when you jump to its terminal.

barWidget.description: A keyboard-first session browser for Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode.
